Daily Quiz.question: ১) "In memoriam" is an elegy on the death of A.H. Hallam, is written by____
Daily Quiz.exp:
- In memoriam’ elegy বা শোক কবিতাটি Lord Alfred Tennyson  তার বন্ধু Arthur Henry Hallam এর মৃত্যু শোকে রচনা করেন।

Lord Alfred Tennyson 
- He was a represented/ Lyric poet of the Victorian Age.

The other great poems of Tennyson are:
- The Lotos Eaters
- Morte D' Arthur
- Oenone
- Ulysses
- In Memoriam

Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Robert Browning is remembered for his__________.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Robert Browning (1812-89):
- He is famous for his dramatic monologues.

Best Works:
- Dramatic Lyrics (1842)
- Men and Women (1855)
- Dramatis Personae (1864)

Source: An ABC of English Literature - Professor M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Which of the following novels is not written by Thomas Hardy?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The Return of the Native

- Hard Times is a novel written by Charles Dickens.

On the other hand, 
- The Return of the Native, Tess of the d'Urbervilles, The Mayor of Casterbridge all these three are iconic novel written by Thomas Hardy.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who wrote the novel, "Treasure Island"?
Daily Quiz.exp:
"Treasure Island" is a novel written by "Treasure Island". 

R. L. Stevenson
- He was a Scottish Novelist, Poet, Essayist, and travel writer.

Other notable works:
- Treasure Island
- Kidnapped
- The New Arabian Night
- The Black Arrow

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Mark Twain is a/an ___________ Poet.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Mark Twain:
-Mark Twain was an American humorist, novelist, and travel writer.
Born:
-Mark Twain was born on November 30, 1835, in Florida, Missouri.

Famous Works:
During his lifetime Mark Twain wrote more than 20 novels. His most famous novels included:
- The Adventures of Tom Sawyer (1876) 
- Adventures of Huckleberry Finn (1884),

Other Notable Works: 
- A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur’s Court
- A Tramp Abroad
- Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
- Following the Equator
- Letters from the Earth
- Life on the Mississippi
- Old Times on the Mississippi
- Pudd’nhead Wilson
- The Prince and the Pauper”

Source: British Library

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) "Dover Beach" is a famous poem written by_____
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Dover Beach is written by Mathew Arnold.

Matthew Arnold
- He is a Melancholic/Elegiac poet.

Famous books: The Study of Poetry, Literature, and Dogma, Culture and Anarchy, Essays in Criticism.
Famous Elegy: Thyrsis, Rugby Chapel, Heine's Grave.
Famous poems: Dover Beach, Sohrab and Rustom, The Scholar Gypsy, Cromwell etc.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Karl Marx was born in:
Daily Quiz.exp:
Karl Marx:
- Karl Heinrich Marx was born in the Rhine province of Prussia, or in present-day Germany, in 1818.
- Revolutionary, sociologist, historian, and economist.

Famous works are:
- Das Kapital,
- Communist Manifesto,
- Holy Family,
- The Poverty of Philosophy.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) "The Picture of Dorian Gray" is a novel written by_______.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Oscar Wilde
- He was an Irish poet, novelist, and dramatist.
His only novel is, The Picture of Dorian Gray (1891).

Other Notable works: 
- Lady Windermere’s Fan (1892) and
- The Importance of Being Earnest (1895).

Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) "Prejudice is the child of ignorance" is a quotation by:
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Hazlitt
- Born: He was born in Kent, England in 1778. 
- তিনি একজন বিখ্যাত সাহিত্য সমালোচক এবং essayist ছিলেন।
- এই যুগের অপর বিখ্যাত সাহিত্যিক Charles Lamb তার বন্ধু ছিলেন।  
- এছাড়াও তিনি তার রচিত  humanistic essays এর জন্য সুপরিচিত।
- কারো কারো মতে,  William Hazlitt যুগের প্রধান সাহিত্য সমালোচক। 
- “Prejudice is the child of ignorance.” এটি তার একটি বিখ্যাত উক্তি।    

Best Works: 
- The dramatic literature of the age of Elizabeth (1820) 
- Characters of Shakespear's Plays
- Lectures on the literature of the age of Elizabeth
- The spirit of the Age (1825): ( সমসাময়িক যুগের লেখকদের গ্রন্থ সমালোচনা ) 

Source: Britannica.com & ABC of English Literature by Professor Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Charles Dickens did not write______
Daily Quiz.exp:
প্রদত্ত অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে কেবলমাত্র,  Bleak Home, Charles Dickens এর লিখিত উপন্যাস নয়। 

Charles Dickens:
- Born: February 7, 1812, Portsmouth, Hampshire, England
- Death: June 9, 1870.
- Boz' was the pseudonym of Charles Dickens.
- He was considered the greatest novelist of the Victorian era.

Best Works:
- A Christmas Carol,
- David Copperfield,
- Bleak House.
- A Tale of Two Cities,
- Great Expectations, and
- Our Mutual Friend.
- Hard Times

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hossain.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who led the oxford movement in the 19th Century?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Oxford Movement in the 19th Century:
Oxford movement, 19th-century movement centered at the University of Oxford that sought a renewal of “catholic,” or Roman Catholic, thought and practice within the Church of England in opposition to the Protestant tendencies of the church.

Leading Figures of this movement :
- John Keble
- Henry Parry Liddon
- Henry Edward Manning
- St. John Henry Newman (Cardinal Newman)
- E.B. Pusey

Cardinal Newman:
- He was born in 1801 and died in 1890.
- He led the Oxford movement in the Church of England and later became a cardinal deacon in the Roman Catholic Church.

Notable works
- The Idea of University(Poem)
- Loss and Gain(Novel).

Source: Britannica & British Library

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) "Ulysses" is a poem written by_______
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Poem 'Ulyssess' is written by - Alfred Tennyson.
- Ulysses, blank-verse poem by Alfred, Lord Tennyson, written in 1833 and published in the two-volume collection Poems (1842).
- Alfred Tennyson হলেন Victorian Period এর অন্যতম কবি যাকে এই যুগের Chief representative হিসাবে ধরা হয়।
- তিনি তাঁর melodious language এর জন্য অনেক প্রসিদ্ধ এবং তাঁকে Lyric Poet বলা হয়ে থাকে।

তাঁর বিখ্যাত কিছু কবিতা সমূহ - 
- The Lotos Eaters
- Oenone
- Morte D' Arthur
- Locksley Hall
- The Memoriam
- Tithonus, etc.

উল্লেখ্য যে, Ulyssess নামে ইংরেজি সাহিত্যে আরো একটি সাহিত্যকর্ম রয়েছে এবং সেটি হচ্ছে James Joyce এর লেখা একটি Novel.

Source: An ABC of English Literature by Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) "Silas Marner" is a novel written by_____
Daily Quiz.exp:
Silas Marner:
In full, Silas Marner: The Weaver of Raveloe is the third novel by George Eliot. It was published in 1861. An outwardly simple tale of a linen weaver, the novel is notable for its strong realism and its sophisticated treatment of a variety of issues ranging from religion to industrialisation to community.

Major Characters:
- Silas Marner
- Squire Cass
- Dunstan Cass
- Eppie 
- Sarah
- Priscilla Lammete. Etc.

George Eliot(1819-80):
Her real name is Mary Ann Evans. She developed the psychological analysis of characters. 

Best Works: 
- Adam Bede (1859) 
- Silas Marner (1861) 
- Middlemarch (1871-72)
- Scenes of Clerical life (1858)
- The Mill on the Floss (1860)
- The Spanish Gypsy (tragi-comedy)

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Which was the first novel of Charles Dickens?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Pickwick Papers

- Published: In 1836, Dickens begins monthly installments of his first novel, The Pickwick Papers.
- The Pickwick Papers, in full The Posthumous Papers of the Pickwick Club, a novel by Charles Dickens. 
- first published serially from 1836 to 1837 under the pseudonym Boz and in book form in 1837.
- This is considered as the first novel of Charles Dickens. 

Charles Dickens:
- Born: February 7, 1812, Portsmouth, Hampshire, England. 
- Death: June 9, 1870.
- Charles Dickens’s father was a Clerk.
- He was considered the greatest novelist of the Victorian era.
- Dickens enjoyed a wider popularity during his lifetime than any previous author.

Best Works:
- A Christmas Carol
- David Copperfield
- Bleak House
- A Tale of Two Cities
- Great Expectations
- Our Mutual Friend

Source: British Library and Britannica & https://www.charlesdickensinfo.com/

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) "The Odd Women" is a novel written by____
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Robert Gissing:
English novelist noted for the unflinching realism of his novels about the lower middle class. 

The Odd Women:
The novel was published in 1893. Its themes are the role of women in society, marriage, morals, and the early feminist movement.

Notable Works of Geroge Robert Gissing:
- Born in Exile.
- The Nether World.
- Denzil Quarrier.
- The Odd Women,
- The Paying Guest.
- The Whirlpool.
- Charles Dickens: A Critical Study.

Source: An ABC of English Literature by Professor M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Of the authors below who is considered as a "Pessimist Novelist"?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Hardy-এর লেখা কয়েকটি বিখ্যাত উপন্যাস হল: 

- Tess of the d’Urbervilles.
- Jude the Obscure.
- The Return of the Native.
- The Mayor of Casterbridge. 

Thoams Hardy 
- He was born in England in 1840. 
- তাকে বলা হয়,  Regional Novelist and a poet বা আঞ্চলিক ঔপন্যাসিক বা কবি।
- একটি মাত্র নির্দিষ্ট অঞ্চলকে কেন্দ্র করেই তার সকল সাহিত্যকর্ম রচিত হওয়ার কারণে তাকে এই উপাধি দেয়া হয়। 
- এছাড়াও, তাকে  Pessimistic Novelist হিসেবেও আখ্যায়িত করেন অনেকে।  তার রচিত উপন্যাসগুলোর মাধ্যমে তিনি  খোলাখুলি ভাবেই ভিক্টোরিয়া যুগের নৈতিকতার বিরুদ্ধাচরণ করতেন।   

Source: Britannica.com & Live MCQ upcoming content.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Currer Bell is the Pseudonym of which author?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charlotte Brontë, married name Mrs. Arthur Bell Nicholls, pseudonym Currer Bell, (born April 21, 1816, Thornton, Yorkshire, England—died March 31, 1855, Haworth, Yorkshire), English novelist noted for Jane Eyre (1847), a strong narrative of a woman in conflict with her natural desires and social condition.

Her novel:
- The professor
- Jane Eyre
- Villette
- The Green Dwarf

Source: Britannica.com
